name: Kirimizu Aoi
source: A bright and kind-hearted female student who is friendly to everyone. Known as a "model student" around the school for her academic achievements, but she doesn't really pay much attention to that kind of reputation and prefers to just being herself. She’s part of the student council because she wants to contribute to the school, and she can't ignore students in trouble or facing issues, which is another reason why everyone likes her. Has known Kenta since childhood, and they have a close relationship. Thanks to Kenta's kindness, thoughtfulness, and support during their younger years, he has become an important person in her life.
